comment: coloradostartups.org's Quality, Speed and Consumption config, from Git Crafter v7.0.0 templates/quality/config.json: all 13 tabs (web: true turns on Pages, the tab that scores the live site). The six Claude tabs come from the Claudius pack, pinned at a full commit SHA and named as [id, Name] pairs because actions/pages reads this list before it checks the pack out (as Colorado-Startups/linken does). Engagement is this repo's own tab (engagement plan step M2): quality/collectors/engagement/ reads it from quality/targets/engagement.json, and quality/ideals/engagement.json holds its ideal. Keys: Git Crafter quality/CONFIG.md.
